content:wysiwyg_basic:1786546784361:0.67.html:
You can make a difference in Greenville. Adopt an Angel today!

The Salvation Army of Greenville Angel Tree program, in collaboration with Toys for Tots, helps provide Christmas gifts for thousands of children in our community each year. Once a child has been registered and accepted as an Angel, their Christmas wish list is shared with donors in our area who purchase gifts of new clothing and toys. The gifts are distributed to the family to place under their family Christmas tree.

content:wysiwyg_basic:1786546858851:0.71.html:
SHOP FOR ANGEL TREE GIFTS

If you'd like to contribute to the Angel Tree program, you can easily and quickly shop one of our online gift registries. The items you purchase for children in need in Greenville will ship directly to our Christmas Distribution Center. We will organize the gifts and share them with families who are unable to provide gifts for their children this year. You can also make a financial contribution, and we can use those funds to help provide clothes and toys to children on our Angel Tree list.
